assets.title: 方案一：点击
assets.image_generation_prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup / compositing. Produce ONE 16:9 landscape actual-gameplay reference frame for Purr Orbit, scenario S1-01: direct single click cat harvest.
Input image 1 is the STRICT environment edit target: the CLOSED-DOOR metallic cabin screenshot. Input image 2 only supports the same cabin perspective and architecture; do NOT open the door.
Preserve image 1's room geometry, camera elevation, floor-tile perspective, central closed door with circular inset, two space windows, two plants, pipes, amber lighting, grey-brown wall panels, and small floor fur piles. Do not redesign the cabin or add equipment. The room remains a pseudo-3D engine screenshot.
Insert exactly THREE living cats as consistent FLAT 2D sprite cards standing on the floor with simple contact shadows: left floor at x31% y65% a round ordinary calico short-haired cat, center x52% y67% an extremely fat black-and-white cat with belly near floor (Liangzi cat), right x75% y64% a cream-white LONG-HAIRED cat whose silky coat trails behind onto the floor like a mop, small cat face visible above the fur curtain. Each character uses the SAME bold thin-dark-outline, flat cel-color style, no realistic fur strands, no volumetric 3D plush modelling, no photorealistic cutouts, no white sticker border. Three full silhouettes clear and nonoverlapping. Cat height about 18% of picture, not giant room-sized pets. Calm deadpan funny faces, not a sugary children's illustration.
Only the left calico is active: a SINGLE small white mouse pointer on its chest, a tiny amber click ripple and slightly squashed springy cat body show a click just happened. ONE '+3' pops above it and TWO small fluffy cream furballs travel on a thin short curving trail toward a top-left resource HUD. No hearts. Center fat cat and right long-haired cat remain ordinary idle and unhighlighted.
UI minimal: top-left compact dark-grey rounded counter with fluffy cream furball icon and number '120'. Top-right small gear. Bottom-left small dark mouse-icon chip labelled '点击' with left button briefly amber, no large title. No cat level, no machine upgrade, no chance panel, no progress ring, no minigame window, no human hand, no player character, no captions, no watermark. ONE cohesive gameplay screenshot, not a storyboard or diagram. Keep the original screenshot's darker muted industrial atmosphere and paper-sprite character look.
